name: test-plugin
description: Connect Test Plugin to a local Mobilerun MCP server using a Node.js stdio bridge.

interface.longDescription: Connect from a compatible desktop-local Work or Codex process through a local Node.js stdio bridge to the local Mobilerun MCP server. POSIX/macOS/Linux and Node.js 20.3 or later are required; Node.js 22 is recommended. This does not connect regular cloud ChatGPT chats. Account, device, and streaming services remain remote.
